_doc: Vintage Bellows line pack: Barnaby, 1973 edition (unlocked by the Cannery's booth tape, secret #5; turned on at Barnaby's desk in the hub). Same format as barnaby.json plus "pack": while a pack is active its lines are preferred for every trigger they cover (Audio.pick_line), and pack lines are never used otherwise.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ladies, gentlemen and assorted critters, in this corner, a fine young scrapper: {p}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Live from the waterfront, brought to you by Glandco tonic: {p}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tune those dials, folks! Stepping in, with a full head of steam: {p}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And they're OFF! Mind your manners and your molars!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Round {n}, and the smoke in this cannery could stand up on its own!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The final round! Somebody fetch the good microphone!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: First blood to the boards, and the gallery approves!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Heavens to Betsy! That one rattled the rafters!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Into the boards like a crate off the morning boat!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: One-two-three, like a waltz with knuckles!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Turned aside, smooth as a dockside card sharp!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DOWN goes the contender! Somebody count, I've lost my glasses!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tossed like a sack of the Tuesday catch!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Hold the presses! This scrapper is NOT finished!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The tonic kicks in! I'm told it's mostly vitamins!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Hanging on by a whisker and a prayer, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten seconds on the big clock! The big clock is slow, but still!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: To the scorecards! And the scorecards favour {p}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Sudden death! One clean shot takes the purse!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: It's OVER! The house lights go up on a brand-new legend!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Clean off the edge! That one's going home by the long way!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Over the ropes and into the night air!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your WINNER, and still champion of my heart: {p}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: {p} takes it! Somebody wire the newspapers!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A draw! The bookmakers are weeping into their visors!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A bit of showmanship! The ladies in the front row are swooning!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: In my day the cage was rope and the rope was mostly rumour.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: This broadcast is reaching homes as far away as the next street!
